topic: How does the 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna influence frequency planning and spectral efficiency for broadband satellite links?
consensus_response: The 11.6% bandwidth of the CTS antenna limits spectral efficiency and increases interference, straining the link budget. Adaptive techniques like dynamic channel allocation and beamforming can optimize frequency planning, while higher-order modulations improve spectral efficiency but require higher signal-to-noise ratios, making them susceptible to interference.
reference_context: CTS antennas have limited bandwidth, affecting satellite communication performance, with axial ratio and reflection coefficient impacting array design and spectral efficiency.
